frozen_transform.fit: 5-iteration Huber IRLS K = intercept + slope*Th, Huber cutoff 1.345 robust residual standard deviations

frozen_transform.rank_score: residual_z * gradient_magnitude, descending, row-major tie break
frozen_transform.output_rule: H49 values unchanged; set selected addition pixels to 1.0
